lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Welcome to Future Land! This farm is yours now.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Select the hoe (1) and press C or left-click to till the soil in front of you.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Plant seeds (3), water them (2), and they'll grow overnight. Press E to harvest when they're ripe.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Sleep in your bed when you're tired. Good luck!
